cohort: Singleton term (37-42 weeks gestation) live births delivered at South-Reunion University's maternity between 2001 and 2019
finding: Optimal gestational weight gain (optGWG) for severe obese women (BMI ≥40 kg/m2) to achieve a newborn weight as close as possible to the 10% SGA/LGA goal is a weight loss of 6 kg.
